tool_input.command:
git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
test(daemon): add internal/daemontest fixtures

SignCommand (gate-3 command signing), FakeSpawner (the one seam this
tier fakes -- daemon.Spawner), GenOwnerKey, EthosOrFatal, and PGP
message builders (BuildPGPSignedMessage/BuildTrustedMessage) for the
combined end-to-end daemon pipeline test.

A separate package rather than internal/testenv/daemon.go as originally
scoped: internal/daemon's own white-box _test.go files already import
internal/testenv, so a helper in testenv that itself imports
internal/daemon closes an import cycle ("import cycle not allowed in
test"), confirmed by trial build. This matches the ratified design
doc's own "Decision: split by reuse potential" section, which already
named internal/daemontest for exactly this reason.

.golangci.yml's existing G204 (gosec) path exclusion is extended to
this package, matching internal/testenv's identical rationale: gpg
invoked with an explicit argument list, never shell=true.
EOF
)"
